Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, i.e.: Low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol greater than 500 mg/dL
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has heterozygous LDLR c.1444G>A mutation and LDL levels exceeding 190 mg/dL, not 500 mg/dL.
Familial hypercholesterolemia is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern, consistent with the patient's heterozygous mutation.
No mention of xanthomas in the patient's history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: LDL receptor negative, i.e.: Receptor binding in cultured fibroblasts no more than 20% of normal OR Genotype with 2 previously described, disease-causing alleles
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a heterozygous LDLR mutation, not two disease-causing alleles.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Advanced coronary heart disease with relatively poor prognosis, i.e: Angina pectoris History of myocardial infarction Positive exercise tolerance test Atherosclerotic disease in proximal aorta or coronary arteries by ultrasound or angiogram
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has recurrent severe myocardial infarctions, coronary artery bypass grafting, and Stage III coronary artery disease with impaired left ventricular function.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of unstable angina in the patient's history.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Left ventricular ejection fraction less than 30%
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has impaired left ventricular function, but exact ejection fraction is not specified.
No mention of decompensated heart failure.
No mention of untreated ventricular tachycardia.
Patient has familial hypercholesterolemia, not other dyslipidemia.
Mild elevation of hepatic transaminases is present, but no obstructive hepatobiliary disease is mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: At least 2 weeks since the following: Drugs affecting cholesterol metabolism
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's current use of cholesterol-lowering medications (e.g., statins) is not explicitly stated.
Patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed at age 48.

Recap: Patient has advanced coronary heart disease (met inclusion criterion) but does not meet homozygous FH requirements (not met) and has diabetes (violates exclusion criterion).
